guidance.summary: Tourism segment revenue is expected to exceed INR 1,000 crores in FY27.
guidance.speaker: Management
guidance.quote: Because tourism is going to grow leaps and bounds. It has grown from INR745 crores to INR890 crores, and next year it may cross INR1,000 plus crores.

guidance.summary: Management aims to return to INR 150 crores in the agent business.
guidance.speaker: Management
guidance.quote: So we will try to come back to INR150 crores in this segment also.
